note: Eight full bibliography entries (each carrying its own Authors/Date/URL/Evidence Level fields) were headed '### ' instead of '#### ' from their November-2025 addition until 2026-07-16, which made them invisible to parse_master_bibliography()'s '(?m)^####\s+' split and therefore to every derived count. The headings were promoted 2026-07-16 (one character each). Because they were invisible at retro-run time, they appear in neither methods/prisma-results/reconciliation.json (which classified the 195 then-visible blocks) nor methods/incorporated-2026-07-13.json; this file supplies their taxonomy classifications as a third dated input. The curated arm's true size at the 2026-07-13 retro-run was therefore 203 entries (179 grey + 24 academic), not 195 (171 grey). All eight are grey vendor/OSS items, none resembling any of the 40 database-arm academic records, so the retro-run's zero-overlap result (0/40 recall) is unaffected; both frozen records are left unedited per the never-retro-edit convention, and this note is the correction of record.
